description: Mellum v4 (neuralese-direct-mellum-v4-from-v3-warmup) handed off in place into the mixed run (owner decision 2026-10-13) by one --handoff of its running direct_sft at a checkpoint: weights, MuonSR state, update counter, data plan, QAT curriculum and RNG continue; the objective continuation adds the e2e_mix component (previous: none), the TokenChoiceProjection starts at the identity with fresh optimizer state, and the writer's rate moves to e2e_mix.writer.lr. Everything else is the parent recipe's. The LFM twin is neuralese-mixed-lfm-qad-broad-v1 (same e2e_mix, lockstep).

e2e_mix.description: The mixed run (owner decision 2026-10-13; plans/neuralese/NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "The mixed run"): the direct stage interleaves e2e producer->consumer updates (train/trajectories.py build_e2e_objective, the e2e stage's edge loss and paired held readers) with its direct updates, on one engine, one NeuraleseProjection (the writer), one TokenChoiceProjection (the token readout, identity-initialised at the handoff) and one optimizer; the precision point, drift monitor, task evaluation and checkpoint are the direct stage's. After direct update i, the e2e cursors floor((i-1)r)..floor(ir)-1 run, r = p/(1-p) (direct_sft.e2e_cursors), so a fraction p of all updates are e2e. fraction 0.25 is a placeholder until measured. The writer is the token-anchored NeuraleseProjection, value = E[chosen] + C(h) (fc32044e): the aligned projection fitted on the parent export (aligned_projection, bound at the handoff from projection_align on that export, gated by projection_on_manifold, the e2e base's thresholds), else C = 0. The TokenChoiceProjection and the writer's C train at 3e-6 on Muon (the e2e collapse dragnet's stable rates, plans/neuralese/E2E_COLLAPSE.md). records/pieces and options are neuralese-e2e-v1's e2e stage data and settings (admitted e2e corpus v3, streamed by trajectory; rate-sweep diagnostics remain pinned to v2); its optimizer, rates, monitor, task evaluation and checkpointing are the host's, and the latents step in the host's backward (no layer-staged backward).

projection_on_manifold.description: Owner 2026-10-13: the NeuraleseProjection value E[chosen] + C(h), made on the exact parent export as the first step of the e2e handoff (train/projection_align.py init), is on the token-embedding manifold before any e2e update. Held positions of the line's own union text data (test split): nearest-token accuracy and cosine to E[chosen] (the readout's argmax), and the mean functional KL of the backbone reading a held span as values instead of E[chosen] embeddings (NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md "The Neuralese value", "Projection alignment fit (2026-10-13)"). Applied by the direct_runtime stage (eval/direct_runtime.py) with train/e2e_acceptance.projection_on_manifold.

objective_continuation.description: The mixed run joins the active direct_sft (owner decision 2026-10-13): e2e_mix is the only changed objective component (none before); the QAT curriculum and family continue unchanged from the handoff update.
